title: Associated Bank Expands Private Wealth Team in Twin Cities
summary: Associated Bank today announced several strategic additions to its Private Wealth team in the Twin Cities, strengthening its trust, fiduciary, wealth planning and private banking capabilities while adding specialized expertise to support continued client growth.
